\textbf{Study design.} 21 held-in annotators in three evidence families (literature 18, motif 2, coexpression 1) report TF--target edges; the ChIP family (4 resources) is held out of every primary fit. The global universe contains 935 literature-covered TFs $\times$ 9{,}963 genes (9{,}314{,}634 ordered pairs, 20{,}278 distinct observation patterns, 43{,}444 edges with at least one report); the tissue-context universes contain the pairs both foundation models can score (immune 323{,}127, kidney 193{,}686, lung 343{,}512 pairs), in which scGPT and Geneformer attention, GRNBoost2 and correlation define predicted sets (top 50 targets per TF). Family-HB assigns every edge a credibility; BFDR tiers (Strong: BFDR $\leq 0.05$; Moderate: $\leq 0.20$) and, in the tissue universes, the dual-universe rule turn credibilities into graded claims; Strong and Moderate edges are promoted (global 7{,}334; immune 493, kidney 276, lung 412). Held-out ChIP-seq references (ENCODE TFBS, 114 TFs; ENCODE-strict, 67; ENETS2, 86) and 7 CRISPR perturbation cohorts from 6 studies enter no primary fit, universe definition or choice of the primary analysis (dashed: evaluation only); the tuning-optimism analysis uses perturbation labels only to measure what tuning on them would gain, and nothing it selects is used elsewhere.
